summary.en: ELN guerrillas used armed drones to kill a Colombian soldier and the Colombian Air Force bombed a guerrilla camp, killing at least three combatants, while FARC also operates armed drones. A stadium collapse in Colombia killed at least four people and a major earthquake has caused more than 224 deaths, with rescue operations ongoing. Russian forces struck a deployment hub in Ukraine used by Colombian mercenaries. The United Nations urged De la Espriella to uphold the peace agreement, and a U.S. indictment has revived former FARC leader Timochenko's name in a Venezuelan case. The UCDP recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ELN-guerrillaer brukte bevæpnede droner for å drepe en colombiansk soldat, og den colombianske luftforsvaret bombet en geriljaleir, hvor minst tre kampere ble drept, mens FARC også opererer med bevæpnede droner. Et stadionkollaps i Colombia drepte minst fire personer, og et stort jordskjelv har forårsaket mer enn 224 dødsfall, med pågående redningsoperasjoner. Russiske styrker rammet et utplasseringsknutepunkt i Ukraina som ble brukt av colombianske leiesoldater. De forente nasjoner oppfordret De la Espriella til å overholde fredsavtalen, og en amerikansk tiltale har gjenopplivet tidligere FARC-leder Timochenkos navn i en venezuelansk sak. UCDP registrerte 225 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
